property_summary: For any call sending exactly 10 ether, the correct contract always updates pastBlockTime to the current block.timestamp on successful fallback execution (so subsequent calls with the same timestamp would be rejected), whereas the mutant that removed the update can leave pastBlockTime unchanged allowing a later call at the same timestamp to be accepted — the test fuzzes block timestamp and block number to find such a case.
change_summary: Remove the update to pastBlockTime so the stored time no longer changes on successful calls, affecting subsequent accept/reject decisions.
